name: SPIDER (SOLITAIRE)
description: Spider is one of the most popular two-deck solitaire games. The goal is to assemble 13 cards of a suit (K down to A) on the tableau, which then automatically removes itself from play. It is typically played with two decks (104 cards). The difficulty varies massively depending on the number of suits used (1 Suit = Easy, 2 Suits = Medium, 4 Suits = Hard).

content.text: Spider is one of the most popular two-deck solitaire games. The goal is to assemble 13 cards of a suit (K down to A) on the tableau, which then automatically removes itself from play. It is typically played with two decks (104 cards). The difficulty varies massively depending on the number of suits used (1 Suit = Easy, 2 Suits = Medium, 4 Suits = Hard).

Spider is a type of patience game and one of the more popular two-deck solitaires. The game originated in 1949; its name comes from a spider's eight legs, referencing the eight foundation piles (complete King-to-Ace same-suit sequences) that must be removed to win. It was said to be a favorite of Franklin D. Roosevelt. Spider became widely known through Microsoft Plus! 98 for Windows 98 (1998) and remains a standard computerized solitaire.
One player only. Spider is a solitaire (patience) game played by a single player against the tableau and stock.
Table space for 10 tableau columns and stock.

Deal 54 cards to the tableau in 10 columns: first 4 columns get 6 cards each, remaining 6 columns get 5 cards each; only the top card of each column is face up. The remaining 50 cards form the stock. When no column is empty, the player may deal 10 more cards from the stock (one to each column).

items.text: Spider 1 Suit: Played with one suit only (usually Spades). Easiest variant; all cards are the same suit so any sequence can be moved.
Spider 2 Suit: Played with two suits (usually Spades and Hearts). Medium difficulty; in-suit builds matter for moving sequences.
Spider 4 Suit: Classic Spider with all four suits. Hardest variant; many deals are unwinnable without undo or luck.
